author: PlsExplaiinn
body:
Hello guys! I would like to be part of the staff team. My game username is PlsExplaiinn. My discord Name is Explaiinn and my discord tag number is 7378. I live in Oahu so my time zone would be HT. I do not have any referee experience but it would be amazing to learn and help out the avicus community. I would like to join so I can help out and be part of the staff team. Yes, I will be able to attend to Saturday tournaments and event staff meetings. Somethings about me. I and 14 years old. I do jiujitsu at the UFC gym Honolulu. I am currently an orange belt. I love to surf and I love to skateboard. I compete in jiujitsu tournments all around the world and I am a photographer. I have two brothers and one sister ( They can get really annoying sometimes.) Im learning how to make good edits and i'm just an outgoing kid, I guess. Thank you for your time! Hopefully I get this staff position. I appreciate this server and all staff who make this server an awesome one. Aloha!

-PlsExplaiinn
